description: Claude Code plugins maintained by kolezka

plugins.name: block-docs
plugins.description: Create and maintain evidence-based block documentation

plugins.name: self-improvement-loop
plugins.description: Background reflection on Claude Code sessions that promotes recurring lessons into skills, hooks, rules and agents, with a local web UI to review and rate them

plugins.name: outline-persist
plugins.description: Durable work-state persistence for Claude Code sessions, backed by the Outline MCP server. Reads prior context before work and records task start, checkpoints, handoff and completion

plugins.name: repo-intel
plugins.description: Install codegraph and graphify in a repository, route the agent to the right graph with near-zero hook overhead, and build the graphify graph on your own LLM backend (LiteLLM, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible) instead of agent subagents
